title: Cookie Management & Tracking Prevention Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk from cookies and tracking. Get personalized recommendations for better cookie management and protection.
description: Assess your current cookie and tracking exposure risk based on your browsing habits, browser settings, and privacy tools. Get actionable recommendations to improve your online privacy and reduce unwanted tracking.

formula: const browserScores = {chrome: 7, firefox: 4, safari: 5, edge: 6, incognito: 2, other: 5}; const cookieScores = {'allow-all': 10, default: 7, 'block-third-party': 4, 'block-all': 2}; const clearScores = {daily: 1, weekly: 3, monthly: 5, rarely: 8}; const toolScores = {none: 8, adblocker: 5, 'privacy-extensions': 3, comprehensive: 1}; const socialScores = {none: 0, light: 2, moderate: 4, heavy: 6}; const browserRisk = browserScores[inputs.browserType] || 5; const cookieRisk = cookieScores[inputs.cookieSettings] || 7; const clearRisk = clearScores[inputs.clearFrequency] || 8; const toolRisk = toolScores[inputs.privacyTools] || 8; const browsingRisk = inputs.browsingHabits * 0.8; const socialRisk = socialScores[inputs.socialMediaUse] || 4; const riskScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((browserRisk + cookieRisk + clearRisk + toolRisk + browsingRisk + socialRisk) / 6 * 10)); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 80 ? 'High Risk': riskScore >= 60 ? 'Moderate Risk': riskScore >= 40 ? 'Low-Moderate Risk': 'Low Risk'; const trackingExposure = Math.min(95, riskScore * 0.9 + (inputs.browsingHabits * 2)); return {riskScore, riskLevel, trackingExposure};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your cookie and tracking risk based on browser choice, privacy settings, clearing habits, and browsing patterns. Browsers like a privacy-focused browser and Firefox offer better default privacy, while regular data clearing and privacy tools significantly reduce tracking exposure.
tips: Switch to privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser for better default protection
Clear cookies and browsing data at least weekly to reset tracking profiles
Block third-party cookies in your browser settings - they're mainly used for tracking
Install privacy extensions or ad blockers to prevent tracking scripts
Be cautious with social media logins on other sites - they enable cross-site tracking
